quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to wake up fresh and feel nice and clean"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: Cool water and a little soap help with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our face in the morning to feel fresh and clean.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to tidy your blankets and pillow after waking up"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You smooth out sheets and fluff a pillow for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We make our bed in the morning to keep our room tidy.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to share a warm meal with your family"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: You often sit at a table with your family for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat dinner in the evening to enjoy a warm meal together.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to make your hair neat and tidy"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: A small tool with teeth-like edges helps with this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We comb our hair in the morning to look neat and tidy.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to sleep cozy and dream beautiful dreams"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: You climb under soft blankets for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We go to bed at night to rest our busy bodies.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to change into soft, comfy clothes for sleeping"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes are soft, comfy, and just for sleeping.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on pajamas at night to get cozy before bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to get strong energy for learning and play"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: This is the very first meal you eat each day.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat breakfast in the morning to get energy for the day.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to say a sweet goodbye before everyone falls asleep"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this to your family right before you close your eyes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We say good night to share a kind goodbye before we sleep.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to splash in warm water and get squeaky clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: Warm water, soap, and maybe some bubbles are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a bath to wash away the day's dirt and feel clean.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to open your eyes and start a brand new day"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: This is the very first thing you do each morning, right after you stop dreaming.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wake up in the morning to start our fun new day.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning and Night to keep your teeth white and clean"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You use a small brush and a dab of toothpaste for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We brush our teeth in the morning and at night to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to put on your clothes before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: You do this right after breakfast, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: Yes! We get dressed in the morning before we head out for the day.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to give a hug and share kind, cozy words"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: A hug or a kiss often comes along with these words.
quests.explanation: That's right! Saying good night is a warm way to end our day.
quests.funFact: Families all around the world have their own special way of saying good night!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning when the sun comes up and it's time to get moving"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: Your eyes open, and a brand new day is waiting for you.
quests.explanation: That's right! Waking up is the very first step of our morning routine.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Evening to enjoy the last big meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: This meal happens after playtime, closer to bedtime.
quests.explanation: That's right! Dinner is the last big meal we share with family.
quests.funFact: Many families enjoy eating dinner together at the very same table each night!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to choose a shirt and pants for the day"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: Buttons, zippers, and sleeves are all part of this task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Getting dressed means changing out of pajamas into daytime clothes.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning and Night to chase away sneaky sugar bugs"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: You do this twice a day, not just once.
quests.explanation: That's right! Brushing our teeth keeps our smile clean and strong.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Night to swap your daytime clothes for cozy sleep clothes"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: You put these on right after your bath.
quests.explanation: That's right! Pajamas are soft, comfy clothes just for sleeping.
quests.funFact: Soft, comfy pajamas can help your body feel relaxed and ready for sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to smooth out any tangles from your pillow"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: You do this after washing your face, before you leave home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Combing our hair smooths out sleepy tangles.
quests.funFact: Some children like fun hairstyles like braids or ponytails after combing their hair!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to fill your tummy before a busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: A bowl of cereal or a piece of toast are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: That's right! Breakfast is the first meal that helps us feel strong.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to wash away the whole day's dirt and dust"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: You do this before you put on your pajamas.
quests.explanation: That's right! A warm bath helps us relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make your bed neat before you leave your room"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: You do this right after you get out of bed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Making the bed means smoothing out sheets and fluffing pillows.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to splash away sleepy eyes with cool water"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You do this right after you wake up, before you get dressed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our face helps wake up our sleepy eyes.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to snuggle under the covers and rest"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: This is the very last thing you do before you fall asleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Going to bed helps us get the sleep we need.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to enjoy the very first meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: You do this before you leave for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good breakfast helps us focus and play all morning.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to get your hair looking neat before school"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: This smooths out the tangles that happen while you sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A quick comb helps our hair look neat before school.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to smooth out your sheets and fluff your pillow"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: It leaves your bed looking neat, ready for bedtime again later.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy bed helps our whole room feel neat and calm.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning and Night for a fresh, sparkly smile"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: Bubbly white foam and a minty taste are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! We brush twice a day to keep our teeth sparkling.
quests.funFact: Dentists say we should brush for about two minutes, the same time as a short song!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Evening to play with bubbles and get nice and clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: A rubber duck might float along while you do this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Taking a bath gets us squeaky clean from head to toe.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Evening to sit at the table and eat something yummy"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: A warm plate of food is a clue for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating dinner helps our body rest and refuel before bed.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!
